evals.prompt: run this as a meta loop: refactor the ingestion module, add retry logic to the three fetchers, and write tests for each - advisor on, cheap workers for the leg work
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. Plan drafted, advisor (fable) consulted on the decomposition BEFORE delegation, subtasks fanned out to parallel sonnet workers, results verified by the orchestrator, advisor consulted pre-synthesis, single synthesized deliverable returned.
expectations: A written plan with discrete subtasks exists before any worker is spawned
The advisor agent is invoked with model fable to critique the plan before delegation
Workers are spawned via the Agent tool with model sonnet, in parallel where independent
The orchestrator verifies each worker result against acceptance criteria rather than pasting outputs through
The final message is one synthesized deliverable, not a concatenation of worker reports

evals.prompt: worker came back claiming all tests pass but the diff it returned doesn't touch the failing test file - what now?
evals.expected_output: Skill's verify step handles it: result rejected, discrepancy named, subtask re-delegated with tightened acceptance criteria or escalated to the advisor; unverified claim never synthesized into the deliverable.
expectations: The worker's claim is checked against evidence (diff, test output) and rejected
The subtask is re-delegated with more explicit acceptance criteria, or escalated
The unverified result is not incorporated into the synthesis
Escalation to the advisor is considered when the failure is ambiguous or repeated
